listing.name: Folklore — Folklore native port (dawoodtogoo2020-code) (dawoodtogoo2020-code)
listing.summary: The public Owner Build Kit has been installed locally on the developer’s PC. Results from private builds do not establish gameplay in the public kit. Setup on a clean machine and physical motion controls remain unconfirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted Folklore game files. This guide does not specify the required serial number or version; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the public Windows Owner Build Kit with Install.py to generate metadata, translate and build locally. Install Python and MSYS2 Clang64 separately. Check INSTALL.md for the exact supported input version before setup; it is not confirmed here.

warnings: The public Owner Build Kit has been installed locally on the developer’s PC. Results from private builds do not establish gameplay in the public kit. Setup on a clean machine and physical motion controls remain unconfirmed.
